prompt:
FLAT SOLID MAGENTA BACKGROUND #FF00FF filling every pixel behind the figure. NOT white, NOT grey, NOT mauve, NOT cream, NOT a gradient, NOT a porch, NOT a room — flat pure magenta only. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane, no frame, no text, no watermark.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, HEAD TO FEET, both feet resting at the very bottom edge of the frame, the whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of both shoes. NOT a bust, NOT a portrait, NOT cropped at the waist or the knees. A single character, standing, facing the viewer.

A young man in his late teens with a warm open smile and bright blue eyes, a full head of loose CURLY MID-BROWN HAIR falling over his forehead. He wears a chunky cream cable-knit crewneck sweater, slim dark denim jeans and simple tan canvas shoes.

HE IS HOLDING A UKULELE — a small four-string soprano ukulele with a warm honey-brown wooden body and a round soundhole, MUCH SMALLER THAN A GUITAR, about the length of his forearm. He holds it up against his chest, his left hand on the short neck making a chord and his right hand resting over the strings mid-strum. The whole instrument must be inside the frame and clearly a ukulele, not a guitar.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Head to feet, full length, both feet at the bottom edge.
